Nora H: Hey folks, first week here. Trying to finish on-call setup: can't see the PagerDuty 'oncall' group in Okta and unsure which runtime runbook is the single source of truth. Anyone point me to the correct doc and help with PD access?
Jesse P: Welcome! Confluence runtime-oncall is canonical. GH runbooks are snapshots; Confluence has the living escalation matrix. For PD access you need org:engineers in Okta first.
Nora H: I clicked request on Okta but it failed with 'insufficient privilege to view group'.
IdP Bot: Automated request created: idp-1766007902. If auto-approval fails, IdP team will follow up.
Ken L: Pinged IdP team. Nora, paste your Okta email here so I can run a manual sync.
Nora H: nora.hayes@redwood.com
IdP Bot: Manual sync queued (sync-1766007925). Estimated 90s.
Jesse P: We've got a 1:1 shadow slot available. Shadow rotation is read-only for high-sev by default; you'll still get low-sev test pages to practice ack/phone flows.
Oncall Bot: Shadow rotation assignment posted: Nora H -> oncall-shadow (start 1766012000).
IdP Bot: Manual sync complete. Group mapping will be pushed to PagerDuty shortly.
Nora H: I accepted PD invite but when I tried to ack the test page I saw "You do not have permission to acknowledge".
Ken L: That means role mapping didn't attach. Re-syncing PD mapping now.
Oncall Bot: Test page created by Ken L at 1766008100. Use /ack to acknowledge.
Nora H: Ack worked after the re-sync. Heard the phone callback and saw escalation info in metadata. Thanks.
Jesse P: Quick escalation rules from the runbook: 0-3m initial ack, 3-8m phone primary, 8-20m escalate to infra lead automatically, 20+m IC activated. Numbers and policy names are linked in Confluence.
Nora H: Found a minor typo in the staging drain example (missing --dry-run). I'll open a tiny PR to fix GH and add a short onboarding note in Confluence when I'm done shadowing.
Ken L: Please add label [onboarding-fix]. Also, after your shadow week, add one sentence under Confluence "recent onboardings" about any gaps you hit. That helps keep the playbook current.
Nora H: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/527. I'll join the shadow kickoff tomorrow 09:30 and take the phone escalation drill. Appreciate the help! :thumbsup:
